mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.status, o.store_id, s.store_name, o.start_date, o.end_date, o.rent_days, o.vehicle_count, o.rent_amount, o.deposit_amount, o.total_amount, o.credit_level_snapshot, o.deposit_coefficient, o.create_time, o.pay_time, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(oi.vehicle_name SEPARATOR ' / ') FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id) AS vehicle_names, (SELECT COALESCE(vi.image_url, m2.cover_image) FROM order_item oi JOIN vehicle v ON v.id = oi.vehicle_id JOIN vehicle_model m2 ON m2.id = v.model_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_image vi ON vi.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE oi.order_id = o.id ORDER BY oi.id, vi.sort_no, vi.id LIMIT 1) AS cover_image, (SELECT oi.vehicle_id FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id ORDER BY oi.id LIMIT 1) AS first_vehicle_id
mapper.select: SELECT , o.return_store_id, (SELECT rs.store_name FROM store rs WHERE rs.id = o.return_store_id) AS return_store_name, o.remark, o.cancel_reason, o.cancel_time, o.pickup_time, o.return_apply_time, o.return_time, o.finish_time, o.overdue_days, o.late_fee, o.deposit_refund_status, o.credit_score_snapshot FROM lease_order o LEFT JOIN store s ON s.id = o.store_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE o.id = #{orderId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.user_id = #{userId}
